qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unassailable national liquidity network effects and clearing monopolies across cash equities (TSX, TSXV), financial derivatives (Montreal Exchange), and central securities depository settlement (CDS, CDCC). Proved by 5Y median ROIC of 14-32%, operating margins >45%, and uncontested pricing power on corporate listing fees, trading execution tariffs, clearing tariffs, and proprietary market data feeds (Trayport, VettaFi, TMX Datalinx). Primary erosion risks: market share erosion in cash equity trading from alternative trading systems (ATS/dark pools), resource IPO underwriting cycle downturns, and OSC regulatory fee scrutiny.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Canadian national exchange and clearinghouse monopoly (TSX, MX, CDS, CDCC) paired with high-recurring global energy and market data platforms (Trayport, VettaFi). Demonstrated multi-cycle pricing power across listing tariffs, clearing fees, and proprietary data subscriptions with 5Y median ROIC >14% and operating margins >45%. Passes Gate 6 as low automated interest coverage is an IFRS gross-reporting artefact of clearing participant repo flows; true corporate net debt is ~2.0-2.3x EBITDA with >8.5x interest coverage and >100% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: trading/clearing volume 2.5% + market data/Trayport recurring SaaS 3.5% + tariff indexation 1.5% + net buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of ~14% (operating ROIC >25-30% on tangible capital). Multi-year FCF conversion of 113.4% (TTM operating cash flow $764.8M vs capex $121.2M and net income $415.7M). Operates essential Canadian capital market infrastructure: TSX/TSXV national equity exchanges, Montreal Exchange (MX) financial derivatives, and CDS/CDCC clearinghouses (>90% Canadian equity and fixed-income settlement). High-margin data platforms (Trayport European energy trading, VettaFi indexation) now represent over 50% of revenue, transforming the earnings profile into recurring subscription ARR. Balance sheet carries C$1.84B in long-term debentures (maturing 2028-2036) and C$210M commercial paper against C$348M cash; corporate net debt to EBITDA is ~2.3x and true corporate interest coverage is >8.5x (excluding CDCC/CDS gross participant pass-through interest). 12.5% multi-year EPS CAGR with steady dividend growth.
